helpMenu.title: How GeoPS works
helpMenu.step1: Pick your district or share your location and see deals a few minutes away.
helpMenu.step2: Reserve without paying: you get a code.
helpMenu.step3: Show the code at the store and pay there.

baseline.title: Your current situation
baseline.intro: Tell us how many customers you serve per week and how much each one spends on average. We use it to compare every campaign against what you already sell without GeoPS. You can skip it and declare it later in Metrics.

result.REJECTED: We could not verify your business

RUC_NOT_FOUND.title: Your RUC is not in the SUNAT registry
RUC_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check with SUNAT that the RUC is registered to you. If the RUC in your profile is mistyped, write to us to fix it.

TAXPAYER_NOT_ACTIVE.title: Your RUC is deregistered at SUNAT
TAXPAYER_NOT_ACTIVE.fix: Reactivate your RUC at SUNAT and verify again from here.

TAXPAYER_NOT_HABIDO.title: Your RUC is listed as not located (no habido)
TAXPAYER_NOT_HABIDO.fix: Update your tax address at SUNAT until it is listed as located (habido) and verify again.

ADDRESS_NOT_GEOCODABLE.title: We could not find your address on the map
ADDRESS_NOT_GEOCODABLE.fix: Correct it below with street, number and district. Your RUC and everything else you registered are kept.

GEOCODER_UNAVAILABLE.title: The map service is not answering right now
GEOCODER_UNAVAILABLE.fix: You do not have to do anything.

INVALID_RUC.title: The RUC is not valid
INVALID_RUC.fix: Check the 11 digits of the RUC in your profile.

verifyBusiness.pendingNote: We retry on our own every 10 minutes. The result will show here and on your dashboard; you can keep creating campaigns meanwhile.

how.title: How it works
how.step1: We check that your RUC is active and located (habido) in the SUNAT registry.
how.step2: We place your store address on the map.
how.step3: If everything is fine, your offers show the verified seal.

verifyBusiness.hintVerified: Your business is verified and your offers show the seal. If you move, verify it again from here.
